requirements.contract: Record artifact identity, path, target, compiler identity, source digest, and SHA-256 of the exact built bytes.
Record exactly one successful build event whose artifact SHA-256 matches every later run.
Record no build event after the first run begins and require rebuild_observed=false on every run.
Record at least two strictly ordered post-build runs of the same artifact with differing runtime inputs.
Each run records runtime origin, concrete inputs and input digest, stdout and stderr digests, exit status, and start and finish times.
Observe environment, file, HTTP, prior-function-result, and stdin values after build using the same artifact hash.

negative_cases.expected: language.iteration_control_not_qualified because a compiler-known value is not runtime-origin proof
language.iteration_control_not_qualified because a declared receipt contract is not an executed receipt
language.iteration_control_not_qualified because source or test markers are not direct-native execution
language.iteration_control_not_qualified because build-once/run-many forbids rebuild between runs
language.iteration_control_not_qualified because static fixture output is not runtime-origin proof
language.iteration_control_not_qualified because compiler projection cannot replace runtime iteration
